purpose: Verified 10-record batch 126 from the 171-record difficult reference-dependent tail. Five Planar Handbook / Spell Compendium summon families were pairwise reviewed. All explicit timing, control, descriptor, grouping, and printing-specific text differences are preserved; external creature/stat-block mechanics remain named source references.

spells/summon-greater-elemental-2170.name: Summon Greater Elemental
spells/summon-greater-elemental-2170.effectSummary: Summons one greater air, earth, fire, or water elemental from the appropriate Elemental Plane. It appears where designated and acts immediately on your turn, understands your speech regardless of language, and follows commands to the best of its ability. You must concentrate to maintain the spell, but commanding it is a free action. This Planar Handbook printing explicitly states that the summoned creature cannot summon/conjure another creature and cannot use teleportation or planar-travel abilities. The spell gains the corresponding air, earth, fire, or water descriptor based on the elemental chosen. Casting time is 1 full round; range Close; duration concentration up to 1 round/level + 1 round; no save; no spell resistance.
spells/summon-greater-elemental-2170.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Pairwise checked against the Spell Compendium reprint. The external greater-elemental stat block remains a Monster Manual reference; the Planar Handbook's explicit no-summoning/no-teleport sentence is preserved.

spells/summon-elysian-thrush-2169.name: Summon Elysian Thrush
spells/summon-elysian-thrush-2169.effectSummary: Summons an Elysian thrush from the Blessed Fields of Elysium for 8 hours. The bird has no significant combat utility; living creatures within 30 feet that listen to its song while resting recover at twice the normal natural-healing rate. Casting time is 10 minutes; range Close; saving throw none; spell resistance no.

spells/heavenly-host-2154.name: Heavenly Host
spells/heavenly-host-2154.effectSummary: Summons a host of archons from Celestia. When casting finishes, 2d4 lantern archons appear; 10 minutes later, 1d4 hound archons appear. Each arrives with maximum hit points per Hit Die and serves for the spell's duration. They obey you explicitly, never attack you even if another creature gains control over them, require no concentration to maintain control, and can be dismissed singly or in groups. Casting time is 10 minutes; range Medium; the creatures must be within the spell's 30-foot grouping limit; duration 10 minutes/level (D); no save; no spell resistance.
